notes: Chat goes to `http://chat.invalid/v1/chat/completions`, embeddings to `http://embed.invalid/v1/embeddings` (the test config's URLs); the host's llama.cpp servers take the same paths.
Only the Notion requests that seed the page mirror run against tests/fake_notion.py in-process; they are not recorded here (see testdata/golden/notion).
